# matriXO

> matriXO runs hands-on technical workshops, hackathons, bootcamps and career programs for students in India, and builds StudentVault, a directory of free tools and offers for students.

Contact: hello@matrixo.in

## Programs

- [Events](https://matrixo.in/events): All upcoming and past events. Supports `?q=` search, e.g. https://matrixo.in/events?q=hackathon
- [Event pages](https://matrixo.in/events/devagentic-2-0): Each event has its own page with date, venue, agenda, pricing and registration.
- [Services](https://matrixo.in/services): Workshops, hackathons, bootcamps and career events matriXO runs for colleges.

## StudentVault

- [StudentVault](https://matrixo.in/studentvault): Free and discounted tools for students (developer packs, cloud credits, software), with eligibility and how to claim.

## Company

- [Why matriXO](https://matrixo.in/home): What matriXO does and who it is for.
- [About](https://matrixo.in/about): Story and mission.
- [Team](https://matrixo.in/team): The people behind matriXO.
- [Careers](https://matrixo.in/careers): Open roles and internships, with an application form.
- [Contact](https://matrixo.in/contact): Contact form for students, colleges and partners.
- [Brand kit](https://matrixo.in/brand): Logos, colours and usage guidelines, downloadable.
